name: Abdelmadjid Cherfaoui
title: Are Devs still needed? Let's code it out
description: AI tools can now generate code, refactor legacy modules, and even spin up full features in minutes. It looks magical until that code meets real-world constraints, real users, and real systems. In this tech show and tell, we explore where AI-powered “vibe coding” starts to crack. More importantly, we show how developer expertise steps in to design resilient systems, make informed trade-offs, and take responsibility for outcomes.
